answer: Sybil rings fake economic life by wash-trading between puppets; a counterparty-diversity threshold blocks it. Each identity must settle trades with 40 unrelated counterparties per epoch — peers on one referral ledge never count as distinct. An honest timber merchant's ledger shows buyers across the whole horizon; a clique collapses into one cluster and its volume is discarded. Cost: 1,000 puppets need 40,000 real trades, ~$40,000 in fees per epoch, linear in N and unpoolable; honest trading qualifies for ~$40. Real volume keeps its reward share; fake volume counts for nothing.
